page_title: EIN 1-3 RBL | Eintracht Frankfurt v RB Leipzig 18/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Bastian Dankert has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' The attendance is 58500.
90+4' Ole Werner has decided to substitute Lukas Klostermann and he is replaced by Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig).
90+3' Substitution. Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig) in, Antonio Nusa out.

90+2' A pass travels right across the box to Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper low in the middle of the goal, but Michael Zetterer denies him with a decent save.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a rough challenge and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul.
87' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the left post! What a huge opportunity!
84' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the left of the target.
84' Eintracht Frankfurt failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
81' It is time for a substitution. Elias Baum (Eintracht Frankfurt) is on for Arthur Theate.
81' 1 - 3 Goal! Antonio Nusa provides Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom left corner. 1:3.
79' Here is a change. Max Finkgrafe is going off and Ole Werner gives the last tactical orders to David Raum (RB Leipzig).
79' Substitution. Romulo Cardoso will be replaced by Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig).
77' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt).
76' RB Leipzig are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
74' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from RB Leipzig comes to nothing.
74' Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) has a great chance on the edge of the six-yard box following a lofted pass, but his header lacks accuracy and flies just past the right post.
73' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for an infringement.
72' Hugo Larsson goes off the pitch and Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on.
71' Albert Riera has decided to make a change. Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Ayoube Amaimouni.
70' 1 - 2 What a beauty from just outside the box! Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power inside the left post.
66' Eintracht Frankfurt can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

66' What a wonderful moment! Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a perfect pass in the middle of the pitch, lines up the ball and unloads a powerful strike towards the top right corner. His effort fails to surprise Maarten Vandevoordt, who makes a nice save.
65' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes a short corner kick.
64' The referee signals a substitution. Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) is brought on as a substitute for Oscar Hojlund.
63' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Michael Zetterer has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
61' The corner is swung in but RB Leipzig can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

61' What a great touch by Brajan Gruda (RB Leipzig) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot towards the roof of the net, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to RB Leipzig.
59' Substitution. Assan Ouedraogo leaves the pitch and is replaced by Brajan Gruda (RB Leipzig).
58' Assan Ouedraogo (RB Leipzig) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

57' Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Michael Zetterer makes a comfortable save.
56' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

53' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
53' Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
52' The linesman points to the corner flag, RB Leipzig are going to take it.
51' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just over the bar.

51' Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Maarten Vandevoordt makes a decent save to deny his effort directed low to the middle of the target.
49' The corner kick from Max Finkgrafe (RB Leipzig) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

47' What a wasted opportunity by Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Michael Zetterer makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
46' Bastian Dankert blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
42' Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and flies well wide of the left post.
40' Max Finkgrafe (RB Leipzig) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
38' Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
37' RB Leipzig take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
37' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick.
37' The total number of attempts is 4:9.
37' RB Leipzig are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
34' 1 - 1 Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) rises high to beat the goalkeeper with a perfect header. He heads the ball inside the right post.
34' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort well wide of the right post.
30' A cross from a corner kick by RB Leipzig is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

30' Assan Ouedraogo (RB Leipzig) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! The referee points to the corner flag and RB Leipzig will take a corner.

27' 0 - 1 Goal! Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box inside the right post. Michael Zetterer had no chance of reaching it. The score is 0:1.
25' Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul.
25' Eintracht Frankfurt take a short corner kick.
24' Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Now Eintracht Frankfurt have a corner.

22' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Maarten Vandevoordt pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
19' Eintracht Frankfurt players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
16' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
13' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
12' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
10' What an opportunity! Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) latches on to a perfect cross from the wing and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes narrowly over the crossbar!
8' Fine play by Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles over the bar.
6' Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot goalwards, but the keeper produces a decent save!
5' Maarten Vandevoordt displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
3' Eintracht Frankfurt keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Eintracht Frankfurt will kick-off.
Bastian Dankert will supervise the game today.
